title: Array Upper Bound
description: Write code that enhances all arrays such that you can call the `upperBound()` method on any array and it will return the last index of a given `target` number. `nums` is a sorted ascending array of numbers that may contain duplicates. If the `target` number is not found in the array, return `-1`.

examples.explanation: Last index of target value is 2
Because there is no digit 2 in the array, return -1.
Last index of target value is 5

constraints: nums is sorted in ascending order.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Array Upper Bound.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
